title: Dinomaly2: A Unified Framework for Unsupervised Image Anomaly Detection
mechanism: Reconstruction on frozen DINO features with noisy bottleneck, linear attention and loose reconstruction; one model across classes, few-shot (8 normals) and RGB-IR settings.
adaptation: Supersedes D07's Dinomaly row for the benchmark: one model across 5 sources x 3 layouts; 8-shot variant with per-module-family references for E1; RGB-IR path noted for WattCycle drone IR.
evidence: R: MVTec AD / VisA I-AUROC 99.9 / 99.3 multi-class; 8-shot 98.7 / 97.4; 15 benchmarks incl. multi-view and RGB-3D / RGB-IR.
min_experiment: Benchmark AD track: train once on clean pool, report pixel AUROC, AU-PRO, crack / inactive relF1@2, cell AUROC. As a prior: same offline 30% recovery kill as SuperADD.
